title: SniffEvalResponse
description: Structured answer the LLM must return when evaluating a sniffCSS-diff delta (+ optional sniffCSS-check evidence) for a web page or a Flutter/Dart app. Rigid schema: every field is bounded and `measured` mirrors only the values the tool actually emits, so the pipeline can filter critical regressions automatically without trusting invented numbers.

tristate.description: Tri-state compliance exactly as emitted by the `contrast` facet / check rules.

page_url.description: Evaluated target: a page URL, or `flutter://<device>` for a Flutter/Dart app.

status.description: Overall verdict: REGRESSION_DETECTED if any change is negative, else IMPROVEMENT if there is a clear improvement, else NEUTRAL.

score_change.description: Design/UX quality delta, -100 (heavy regression) to +100 (heavy improvement).

summary.description: One-paragraph human summary of the change and its impact, citing the strongest measured evidence.

node_selector.description: Identity of the changed node exactly as sniffCSS-diff emits it: a web selector/path (e.g. `button[data-testid="submit"]`), a Flutter widget identity (e.g. `FilledButton-[<'counter'>][0]`, widget class as tag), or an interaction-effect delta line (`__actions[N]` for ACTION_CHANGED/ADDED/REMOVED).

category.description: Pillar affected. ACCESSIBILITY: contrast (WCAG AA/AAA), aria/ax role-name-focusable, target size, focus indicator, hidden focusables, empty alt. LAYOUT_STABILITY: rect/metrics deltas, z-index/overlap, is_user_noticeable flips (display_visible, accessibility_grade), occluded elements (behind an overlapping element). VISUAL_HIERARCHY: typography/scale alignment (4px/8px grid), font unification. DESIGN_SYSTEM: uniformity outliers, tokens, surface colors. INTERACTION: UI-effect deltas from actions (modal revealed/hidden, effect moved off-screen, no_effect). PERFORMANCE: judgment-based only, never cite numbers the tool did not emit. OTHER: anything else.

reason.description: Evidence-based explanation citing the before/after values present in the delta or check evidence (e.g. 'contrast.ratio fell from 4.5 to 2.1 (fail AA)' or 'target-size now 22x22 < 24x24'). Never invent numbers.

measured.description: Optional measured signals backing the reason. ONLY fields the tool actually emitted (a delta facet, a snapshot field, check evidence, or an __actions entry). Mirror the tool's field names; do not hand-derive or invent.

large.description: Whether the WCAG large-text thresholds applied.

unknown_reason.description: Why the value could not be measured, when unknown.

geometry.description: From a `rect`/`metrics` delta. Web: CSS px; Flutter: device/logical px as emitted.

uniformity.description: A uniformity outlier (odd instance vs group norm) from sniffCSS-check.

action.description: From an __actions entry / ACTION_* delta: what an interaction revealed/moved and where.

tag.description: Widget class used as the node identity, e.g. `FilledButton`.

accessibility_enabled.description: The `accessibility.enabled` snapshot field (e.g. false for a disabled button).
